item.description:

Maryam Ghanem survived, rescued by Palestinian journalist Ali al-Jaafrawi. The toddler is now an orphan. Her father was killed just months before she was born. She continues to ask for her mom. Maryam herself will forever be haunted by a genocide that she was born into – a genocide that took both of her parents and left her with severe burns. This is the reality children like Maryam face every day as the world continues to stand by as Israel kills, starves, burns. item.title: Oregon father is the latest armed civilian to confront a gunman in a U.S. mass shooting
item.description:
A teacher threw her cellphone at a teenage gunman and tackled him during Thursday’s deadly shooting at an Oregon elementary school, fighting to wrestle away his shotgun before an armed father shot him dead, police revealed Friday . The 16-year-old gunman killed four people, including three children, at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, where he had previously been a special needs student. All of the victims were in a special-needs classroom, school officials said. The teacher was not injured in the confrontation. Her heroic actions “almost certainly helped prevent more bloodshed,” Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz said during a news conference detailing the attack. The father, identified as Kaylub Giamanco , 36, has two children at the school. He witnessed the initial shooting outside and followed the gunman into the school, police said. item.title: Brazil: Amazon deforestation at 40-year low
item.description:
Brazilians filling out presidential ballots earlier this month saw three-term incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva pitted against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Environmental observers saw something else: a referendum on the future of the Amazon rainforest. “We are very serious about the risks for the Amazon if Flávio wins the election, because he is a climate denier,” said Carlos Nobre, a climate scientist currently at the University of São Paulo’s Institute for Advanced Studies. “If this candidate is elected, certainly deforestation in the Amazon will increase. We are in a very serious situation.” Flávio Bolsonaro, son of imprisoned former president Jair Bolsonaro, is campaigning on an agribusiness-friendly, deregulatory agenda . item.title: Mexico sentences killers of US, Australian surfers to 158 years each in prison
item.description:
Three men in Mexico received 158-year prison sentences Friday for the murders of Australian surfers Callum and Jake Robinson and their American friend Carter Redd Rhoad. A federal judge in the town of Ensenada, Baja California sentenced Jesús Gerardo García, Irineo Francisco and Ángel Jesús each to 158 years and nine months in prison for murder, robbery with violence and vehicle theft with violence. An accomplice of García's — Ary Gisell Silva Raya — was also convicted of aggravated robbery with violence and vehicle theft with violence and sentenced to 20 years in November after agreeing to an abbreviated trial. item.title: Ilhan Omar: The US Democrat targeted by Donald Trump
item.description:
Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-MN) speaks during a get-out-the-vote event on Aug. 8, 2026, in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Photo by Stephen Maturen/Getty Images This week’s predawn raid by federal agents of the home of a sitting U.S. lawmaker who is up for reelection just weeks before voters go to the polls sadly, though perfectly, illustrates what the United States has come to represent under Donald Trump: An America where the federal government is used to target the president’s perceived enemies. An America where the rule of law has lost its meaning, an America where fascism no longer hides in the shadows. In this case, the target was Rep. item.title: Ukraine war: "Mothers of Kherson" opera opens in Poland
item.description:
"Mothers of Kherson" has opened at Poland's National Opera. The performance was co-produced with New York's Metropolitan Opera and created in close association with Save Ukraine, a group helping to bring back Ukrainian children who remain in Russia. More than four years after Russia's invasion of Ukraine, the opera aims to "reawaken" global interest in the war.
